Title: FakeClock reports its construction time
Preconditions: FakeClock constructed at symbolic time t0
Stimulus: Call now()
Expected: now().value equals t0.value
Notes: Unit under test is FakeClock (tests/unit/fake_clock.hpp, T4); no external dependency. ST-005 acceptance ID; story row lists TC-SENS-001 (design 3.3)

Title: FakeClock is non-decreasing over repeated advance
Preconditions: FakeClock constructed at symbolic t0; symbolic positive deltas d1 and d2 with t0+d1+d2 not above the maximum uint64 value
Stimulus: Call advance(d1) then now(), then advance(d2) then now()
Expected: Each advance returns Status{Ok, NONE} (is_ok() is true, fault equals NONE); each now() is >= the previous read; reads equal t0+d1 and t0+d1+d2
Notes: Same fixture as TC-SENS-011.1; symbolic deltas, no literals; return type per design 5.2 and DD-6

Title: FakeClock advance by zero yields an equal read
Preconditions: FakeClock constructed at symbolic t0 and read once
Stimulus: Call advance(0) then now()
Expected: advance returns Status{Ok, NONE}; now().value equals the earlier read (equal consecutive reads are valid)
Notes: Monotonic means non-decreasing (design 3.1); resolution TBD so equal reads must be accepted

Title: FakeClock set to the current time is accepted
Preconditions: FakeClock constructed at symbolic t0
Stimulus: Call set(t0)
Expected: Returns Status{Ok, NONE}; now().value equals t0.value
Notes: Design 5.2 table: set(t) with t equal to current is accepted

Title: FakeClock set to a later time moves the clock forward
Preconditions: FakeClock constructed at symbolic t0; symbolic t1 greater than t0
Stimulus: Call set(t1) then now()
Expected: set returns Status{Ok, NONE}; now().value equals t1.value

Title: FakeClock set to an earlier time is rejected and time unchanged
Preconditions: FakeClock constructed at symbolic t0 greater than 0; symbolic tb less than t0 (backward-clock injection)
Stimulus: Call set(tb) then now()
Expected: set returns Status{InvalidArgument, TIME_NON_MONOTONIC} (is_ok() is false); now().value still equals t0.value
Notes: Same code and fault pair as elapsed_us backward time (design 5.2 and DD-6)

Title: FakeClock is readable through the MonotonicClock interface
Preconditions: FakeClock constructed at symbolic t0; reference of type const MonotonicClock& bound to it
Stimulus: Call now() through the base reference
Expected: now().value equals t0.value
Notes: Shows FakeClock implements the interface. FR-071 is not cited: adapter sharing is verified with the adapters (design 7, DD-8)

Title: FaultCode NONE equals zero
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Read static_cast of FaultCode::NONE to its underlying type
Expected: Value equals 0

Title: FaultCode numeric values match the registry table
Preconditions: Expected values taken from design table 5.3 for all 13 enumerators
Stimulus: Read the underlying value of each enumerator, and its high byte
Expected: Values: NONE=0x0000, INIT_STEP_FAILED=0x0101, TIME_NON_MONOTONIC=0x0201, SENSOR_STALE=0x0301, SENSOR_OUT_OF_RANGE=0x0302, SENSOR_IMPLAUSIBLE=0x0303, SENSOR_BUS_ERROR=0x0304, ESTIMATOR_INPUT_INVALID=0x0401, CONTROL_INPUT_LOST=0x0501, COMM_MALFORMED_MESSAGE=0x0601, COMM_UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND=0x0602, WATCHDOG_TASK_HEALTH=0x0701, BATTERY_THRESHOLD=0x0702; high byte equals the category (0x01 init, 0x02 time, 0x03 sensor, 0x04 estimation, 0x05 control input, 0x06 communication, 0x07 safety/platform) for every enumerator except NONE
Notes: Guards append-only numbering. BATTERY_THRESHOLD is checked as a code only, threshold TBD (OD-014). Initial set is proposed by the design and may be refined by owner stories

Title: FaultCode names match the design registry
Preconditions: Expected names taken from design table 5.3 for all 13 enumerators
Stimulus: Call to_string for each enumerator
Expected: to_string returns the enumerator identifier as text for each of: NONE, INIT_STEP_FAILED, TIME_NON_MONOTONIC, SENSOR_STALE, SENSOR_OUT_OF_RANGE, SENSOR_IMPLAUSIBLE, SENSOR_BUS_ERROR, ESTIMATOR_INPUT_INVALID, CONTROL_INPUT_LOST, COMM_MALFORMED_MESSAGE, COMM_UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND, WATCHDOG_TASK_HEALTH, BATTERY_THRESHOLD; never null
Notes: Compares against the design list; table-side completeness is checked by TC-SENS-011.16 to TC-SENS-011.18

Title: FaultCode table values are unique
Preconditions: Entries obtained from fault_code_table()
Stimulus: Compare the code of every pair of distinct entries
Expected: No two distinct entries share a code
Notes: Iterates the real table through the DD-5 seam; no test-local enumerator list

Title: FaultCode table names are unique
Preconditions: Entries obtained from fault_code_table()
Stimulus: Compare the name of every pair of distinct entries by content
Expected: No two distinct entries have equal names
Notes: Iterates the real table through the DD-5 seam

Title: FaultCode table names are non-empty printable ASCII
Preconditions: Entries obtained from fault_code_table()
Stimulus: Inspect the name of each entry character by character
Expected: Name is non-null; length is at least 1; every character is in the printable ASCII range 0x20 to 0x7E

Title: FaultCode table names use upper-case letters and underscores only
Preconditions: Entries obtained from fault_code_table()
Stimulus: Inspect the name of each entry character by character
Expected: Every character is an upper-case ASCII letter or an underscore
Notes: new case derived from design rule in 5.3 (not a new TC ID). Design gap: the rule says upper-case ASCII with underscores and does not mention digits; none of the initial names contain digits

Title: FaultCode lowest and highest registered values print their names
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Call to_string for FaultCode::NONE (lowest, value 0) and FaultCode::BATTERY_THRESHOLD (highest registered)
Expected: Returns NONE for the first and BATTERY_THRESHOLD for the second, neither null nor UNKNOWN

Title: FaultCode table size equals kFaultCodeCount
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Read kFaultCodeCount and fault_code_table() then compare size
Expected: kFaultCodeCount equals 13; fault_code_table().size equals kFaultCodeCount; entries is non-null
Notes: new case closing review F-1 (design 7 completeness seam, DD-5). Residual limit (DD-5): no reflection in C++17, so an enumerator added without updating the count is caught by review only

Title: Every design enumerator appears once in the FaultCode table
Preconditions: Expected enumerators taken from design table 5.3 (13 entries)
Stimulus: Search the entries of fault_code_table() for each design enumerator
Expected: Each of NONE, INIT_STEP_FAILED, TIME_NON_MONOTONIC, SENSOR_STALE, SENSOR_OUT_OF_RANGE, SENSOR_IMPLAUSIBLE, SENSOR_BUS_ERROR, ESTIMATOR_INPUT_INVALID, CONTROL_INPUT_LOST, COMM_MALFORMED_MESSAGE, COMM_UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND, WATCHDOG_TASK_HEALTH, BATTERY_THRESHOLD is found in exactly one entry
Notes: new case closing review F-1 (design 7 each 5.3 enumerator is present in the table)

Title: FaultCode to_string agrees with the table entry names
Preconditions: Entries obtained from fault_code_table()
Stimulus: Call to_string(entry.code) for each entry
Expected: Returned text equals entry.name by content for every entry
Notes: new case closing review F-1 (design 7 to_string(entry.code) equals entry.name)

Title: FaultCode and FakeClock members are declared noexcept
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Compile-time check noexcept for to_string(FaultCode), fault_code_table(), the FakeClock constructor, now(), advance() and set() via static_assert
Expected: All static_asserts hold; test compiles and passes
Notes: new case for NFR-001 structural evidence (design 6, DD-8). No numeric execution-time target (OD-012); timing is measured later (TC-CI-007)

Title: FakeClock default construction starts at zero
Preconditions: FakeClock constructed without arguments
Stimulus: Call now()
Expected: now().value equals 0
Notes: new case for the design 5.2 default argument TimestampUs{0}

Title: FakeClock constructor is explicit
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Compile-time check on TimestampUs to FakeClock via static_assert
Expected: std::is_convertible of TimestampUs to FakeClock is false; std::is_constructible of FakeClock from TimestampUs is true
Notes: new case for the design 5.2 explicit constructor

Title: elapsed_us returns the difference when later is after earlier
Preconditions: Symbolic TimestampUs earlier and later with later greater than earlier
Stimulus: Call elapsed_us(later, earlier)
Expected: is_ok() is true; value() equals later.value minus earlier.value
Notes: new TC ID per design section 7 (marked new there). Pure function of its arguments; no dependency (DD-7)

Title: elapsed_us returns zero when timestamps are equal
Preconditions: Symbolic TimestampUs with later equal to earlier
Stimulus: Call elapsed_us(later, earlier)
Expected: is_ok() is true; value() equals 0
Notes: Equal reads are valid; resolution TBD

Title: elapsed_us accepts later one tick after earlier
Preconditions: Symbolic earlier; later equals earlier.value plus 1
Stimulus: Call elapsed_us(later, earlier)
Expected: is_ok() is true; value() equals 1
Notes: Just-past-equal boundary

Title: elapsed_us rejects later one tick before earlier
Preconditions: Symbolic later; earlier equals later.value plus 1
Stimulus: Call elapsed_us(later, earlier)
Expected: is_ok() is false; status().fault equals TIME_NON_MONOTONIC
Notes: Just-below-equal boundary

Title: elapsed_us handles the maximum timestamp difference
Preconditions: later equals the maximum uint64 value; earlier equals 0
Stimulus: Call elapsed_us(later, earlier)
Expected: is_ok() is true; value() equals the maximum uint64 value
Notes: Type limits only; wrap handling is not implemented (design 5.2)

Title: elapsed_us returns TIME_NON_MONOTONIC when later is before earlier
Preconditions: Symbolic TimestampUs with later less than earlier
Stimulus: Call elapsed_us(later, earlier)
Expected: is_ok() is false; status().code equals InvalidArgument; status().fault equals TIME_NON_MONOTONIC
Notes: Backward-clock injection by argument order

Title: elapsed_us never reports zero or a wrapped value for backward time
Preconditions: later equals 0; earlier equals the maximum uint64 value (wrapped difference would be 1); symbolic sentinel distinct from 0 and 1
Stimulus: Call elapsed_us(later, earlier) then value_or(sentinel) on the result
Expected: is_ok() is false; value_or(sentinel) returns the sentinel
Notes: Backward time must not look fresh (supports FR-012 consumers, ST-021). No stale-sensor Safety Path set: design section 7 states ST-005 adds no stale-sensor path

Title: elapsed_us matches the FakeClock advance
Preconditions: FakeClock at symbolic t0; start captured via now(); symbolic positive delta d with no overflow
Stimulus: Call advance(d) then elapsed_us(now(), start)
Expected: is_ok() is true; value() equals d
Notes: FakeClock only supplies timestamps; elapsed_us takes TimestampUs values (design 5.2). FakeClock reused from TC-SENS-011 fixture

Title: FakeClock advance reaching exactly the maximum is accepted
Preconditions: FakeClock at the maximum uint64 value minus symbolic d
Stimulus: Call advance(d)
Expected: advance returns Status{Ok, NONE}; now().value equals the maximum uint64 value
Notes: Boundary just before saturation (design 5.2 table)

Title: FakeClock advance past the maximum saturates and returns OutOfRange
Preconditions: FakeClock at the maximum uint64 value minus symbolic d, with d less than the maximum uint64 value; delta d plus 1 (overflow injection)
Stimulus: Call advance(d plus 1)
Expected: advance returns Status{OutOfRange, NONE} (is_ok() is false); now().value equals the maximum uint64 value
Notes: Overflow is test-double misuse so the fault is NONE (design 5.2 and DD-6)

Title: Clock interface and elapsed_us are declared noexcept
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Compile-time check noexcept for elapsed_us(a, b) and clock.now() via static_assert
Expected: Both static_asserts hold; test compiles and passes
Notes: Boundedness is checked structurally only; no numeric execution-time target (OD-012); timing is measured later (TC-CI-007)

Title: FakeClock advance by one at the maximum saturates and returns OutOfRange
Preconditions: FakeClock constructed at the maximum uint64 value (overflow injection)
Stimulus: Call advance(1)
Expected: advance returns Status{OutOfRange, NONE}; now().value equals the maximum uint64 value
Notes: new case for design 5.2 table row any d greater than 0 at max

Title: FakeClock advance by zero at the maximum is accepted
Preconditions: FakeClock constructed at the maximum uint64 value
Stimulus: Call advance(0)
Expected: advance returns Status{Ok, NONE}; now().value equals the maximum uint64 value
Notes: new case for design 5.2 table row d equal 0

Title: TimestampUs comparison operators order two distinct values
Preconditions: Symbolic TimestampUs a and b with a.value less than b.value
Stimulus: Evaluate a==b, a!=b, a<b, a<=b, a>b and a>=b
Expected: a==b false; a!=b true; a<b true; a<=b true; a>b false; a>=b false
Notes: new case for the design 5.2 comparison operators

Title: TimestampUs comparison operators treat equal values as equal
Preconditions: Symbolic TimestampUs a and b with equal value
Stimulus: Evaluate a==b, a!=b, a<b, a<=b, a>b and a>=b
Expected: a==b true; a!=b false; a<b false; a<=b true; a>b false; a>=b true
Notes: new case for the design 5.2 comparison operators

Title: Status ok factory yields Ok with no fault
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Call Status::ok()
Expected: code equals Ok; fault equals NONE; is_ok() is true
Notes: new TC ID per design section 7 (marked new there)

Title: Status error factory defaults the fault to NONE
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Call Status::error(InvalidArgument)
Expected: code equals InvalidArgument; fault equals NONE; is_ok() is false

Title: Status error factory keeps code and fault
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Call Status::error(DeviceError, SENSOR_BUS_ERROR)
Expected: code equals DeviceError; fault equals SENSOR_BUS_ERROR; is_ok() is false
Notes: StatusCode and FaultCode stay separate

Title: Result success holds the value and an ok status
Preconditions: Symbolic value v of a trivially copyable T; symbolic fallback distinct from v
Stimulus: Call Result<T>::success(v) then is_ok(), status(), value() and value_or(fallback)
Expected: is_ok() is true; status().is_ok() is true with fault NONE; value() equals v; value_or(fallback) equals v
Notes: NFR-009 is not cited: its verification is TC-CI-010 plus review; value types give by-copy evidence only (design 7 and DD-8)

Title: Result failure carries the status
Preconditions: Status s equals Status::error(DeviceError, SENSOR_BUS_ERROR) (failed-result injection)
Stimulus: Call Result<T>::failure(s) then is_ok() and status()
Expected: is_ok() is false; status().code equals DeviceError; status().fault equals SENSOR_BUS_ERROR

Title: Result value_or returns the fallback on failure
Preconditions: Failed Result built with failure(Status::error(Timeout)); symbolic fallback
Stimulus: Call value_or(fallback)
Expected: Returns fallback
Notes: Failure path of value_or (relabelled from boundary per review F-5)

Title: Result failure with Ok status is coerced to Internal
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Call Result<T>::failure(Status::ok()) then is_ok() and status()
Expected: is_ok() is false; status().code equals Internal
Notes: Design gap: the FaultCode of the coerced status is not specified; not asserted

Title: StatusCode names are non-empty printable and unique
Preconditions: StatusCode values 0 to kStatusCodeCount minus 1 (kStatusCodeCount equals 9)
Stimulus: Call to_string for each value from 0 to kStatusCodeCount minus 1
Expected: Each result is non-null with length at least 1 and only characters 0x20 to 0x7E; no two values return equal strings; none returns UNKNOWN
Notes: Iterates by the DD-5 count (design 5.4); no test-local list. Design gap: exact StatusCode names are not specified, so only relational checks are possible

Title: Out-of-range StatusCode prints UNKNOWN
Preconditions: StatusCode values built by static_cast: kStatusCodeCount, and the maximum uint8 value
Stimulus: Call to_string for each value
Expected: Returns the string UNKNOWN for both; result is never null
Notes: Out-of-range enum injection; to_string(kStatusCodeCount) equals UNKNOWN per design 5.4

Title: Out-of-range FaultCode prints UNKNOWN
Preconditions: FaultCode value 0xFFFF built by static_cast (reserved category 0xFF); value is not present in fault_code_table()
Stimulus: Call to_string for the value
Expected: Returns the string UNKNOWN; result is never null
Notes: Out-of-range enum injection; 0xFFFF is guaranteed unknown by the reserved category so appended codes do not break it (DD-8)

Title: Common value types are trivially copyable
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Compile-time check std::is_trivially_copyable for Status, Result of uint64_t, TimestampUs, FaultCode and StatusCode via static_assert
Expected: All static_asserts hold; test compiles and passes
Notes: NFR-005/NFR-008 evidence is by construction only; the include ban is enforced by TC-CI-004 (ST-004)

Title: Status and Result have no default constructor
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Compile-time check not std::is_default_constructible for Status and Result of uint64_t via static_assert
Expected: Both static_asserts hold; test compiles and passes
Notes: Guards against an uninitialized outcome reading as success

Title: Status and Result accessors and to_string are noexcept
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Compile-time check noexcept for Status::ok, Status::error, is_ok, Result::success, Result::failure, status, value_or, value and to_string(StatusCode) via static_assert
Expected: All static_asserts hold; test compiles and passes
Notes: No numeric execution-time target (OD-012). to_string(FaultCode) noexcept is covered by TC-SENS-011.19; NFR-001 evidence is structural (design 6)

Title: kStatusCodeCount is one past the last StatusCode
Preconditions: none
Stimulus: Read kStatusCodeCount and the underlying value of StatusCode::Internal
Expected: kStatusCodeCount equals 9; kStatusCodeCount equals the underlying value of Internal plus 1
Notes: new case closing review F-1 for StatusCode (DD-5). Residual limit (DD-5): an enumerator added without updating the count is caught by review only

Title: Module-interface document completeness check
Notes: new TC ID per design section 7 (marked new there). Deferred: pytest/automation level (tests/automation/test_module_interfaces_doc.py, T6); no unit cases. Includes seeded negative case for a missing module section
